curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover yielding to pedestrians, visually impaired people, children and school zones.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on crosswalks, white canes, green lights and school zones.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario items on when to yield or stop for pedestrians.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain bicyclists as vehicles, bike lanes, passing room and horn use.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on bike lane rules, space and horn limits.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on bike lanes and passing bicyclists.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover where bicyclists appear and how to read their intentions.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on sidewalks, road surfaces, hand signals and car doors.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on checking for bicyclists before doors and backing.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain giving motorcycles a full lane, following distance and signals.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on lane width, signals and following distance.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on motorcycle signals and following gaps.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain truck limits and no zones.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on no zones and the mirror rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on where truck blind spots are.
